cohort: 135 women undergoing cesarean section with exteriorization of the uterus
finding: Intrathecal nalbuphine is an effective and safer alternative to fentanyl for controlling visceral pain induced by uterine exteriorization during cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Intrathecal nalbuphine is an effective safer alternative to fentanyl to control visceral pain induced by uterine exteriorization during cesarean delivery.
